name: Helen Zukin
office: Presiding Justice, Court of Appeal, Second District, Division Four

items.text: Helen Zukin is the Presiding Justice of the Second District Court of Appeal, Division Four. She served on the Los Angeles Superior Court and spent over three decades in plaintiffs' complex civil litigation. She helped develop a statewide mentor program that walks lawyers through the judicial selection process. In G.G. v. G.S. (2024), she ruled courts cannot make a distinction between physical and non-physical abuse when renewing restraining orders.
